rationale: Control-path temporal plan compilation and data-path evaluation have different inputs, rates, caches, dependencies and substitution seams.
Coverage/restatement calculus and provider write/receipt reconciliation have different authority, purity and failure states.
Online reads form one cohesive request/response/freshness protocol while physical stores and purpose authority remain imported.
Per-request revision selection and long-running guarded traffic transition differ in lifecycle, authority, state, rate and evidence.

Source truth, entity identity, feature definitions, physical query/dataflow execution, scheduling, stores, purpose policy, model lifecycle, assurance, deployment, inference and outcomes remain separately owned.
